name: diffrec
source: Wang et al., Diffusion Recommender Model, SIGIR 2023; github.com/YiyanXu/DiffRec @ e42532f (DiffRec/main.py, models/DNN.py, models/gaussian_diffusion.py, inference.py)
grid_source: The authors' released settings differ per dataset: lr 1e-5 to 1e-3, noise scale 1e-4 to 0.5, steps 5, 10 or 40, dims [1000] (ML-1M [200,600]). 8-trial budget: lr {1e-4, 1e-3} x noise scale {1e-3, 1e-2} x steps {5, 40}; dims [1000], embedding 10, noise range 1e-3 to 1e-2, reweighting on, x0 prediction fixed; our choice. The pipeline's --lr and --reg are ignored (the learning rate is diff_lr).
memory: Rows are built per batch from the sparse matrix (no dense users x items matrix); the first layer is items x 1000 (91.6k x 1000 on Amazon-Book, 0.4 GB with Adam states 1.1 GB); evaluation runs the reverse chain for every user (steps forward passes). Part B measured DiffRec at 47 GB host RAM on Amazon-Book with the authors' dense matrix; this adapter avoids it. Time to be measured on the canary
